1.consolidated_definition: Árbol de hojas redondas, de flores pequeñas y velludas en forma de copa de color verde castaño, y baya con cinco semillas puntiagudas; su madera, de gran dureza, se usa para espeques. Sapotaceae, Micropholis garciniaefolia.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Tree with rounded leaves, small and hairy flowers in the shape of a cup-shaped greenish-brown color, and berry with five pointed seeds; its wood, of great hardness, is used for espeques (presumably referring to a type of wooden tool or implement). Sapotaceae, Micropholis garciniaefolia.
